thread:
incident-bot: PagerDuty alert fired: latency-slo-burn-prod (p99) for route /v1/generate > 6s for 5m; severity: P1. link: https://pagerduty.local/incidents/PD12345

Mira Patel: Acked. I'm on it. grabbing dashboards now.

Samir Rao: saw the spike ~2:50pm UTC, p95 ~800ms -> 1.8s, p99 jumped to 6.3s. Region eu-west shows biggest tail.

Jordan L: any deploys in last 30m?

Mira Patel: checking CI/CD deploys... no model rollouts in last hour. autoscaler events show a lot of queueing on gpu-pool-2.

oncall-sre-bot: cpu/mem/gpu metrics snapshot attached (auto).

Mira Patel: dumping recent request traces for /v1/generate

```
curl -s "https://metrics.redwood/api/v1/query?query=p99_latency{route=\"/v1/generate\"}&time=now"
```
Mira Patel: traces show long KV cache miss latencies on a subset of replicas (replica ids: r-17,r-18). KV stall + prefetch backpressure.

Samir Rao: quick mitigation candidate: route traffic away from r-17,r-18 via traffic-router -> set weight 0 for those replicas. Who can do router update?

Jordan L: I can push a temporary routing rule. prepping patch.

PagerDuty: Reminder: if P1 not acked within 5m escalate to L2.

Jordan L: pushed routing change to exclude r-17,r-18 (config id cfg-773). Confirming cluster accepted new weights.

Mira Patel: metrics: p99 dropped from 6.3s -> 3.1s within 90s. good, still above SLO (2s). some customers still hitting tail.

Kai (support): CX reported chat stalls from customer 'Acme Analytics' across EU. Ticket #INC-8842. They saw timeouts ~8s.

Samir Rao: next step: reduce batching on affected model to reduce queueing. Note: will increase cost. Should we proceed?

Mira Patel: yes, do it. Jordan, can you push a per-route override to batch_size=1 for /v1/generate-eu flag?

Jordan L: applied batch_size=1 override to route; forcing fallback quantization disabled for that route.

Mira Patel: p99 now ~1.9s after batch reduction. p95 ~600ms. Close to SLO.

Samir Rao: root cause hypothesis: intermittent KV cache eviction due to background compaction on pool-2; a couple replicas had degraded IO causing long KV fetches and backpressure that amplified with larger batch sizes.

Mira Patel: opened an infra ticket to investigate disk IO on gpu-pool-2 hosts (HOSTS: gw-12, gw-15). Adding owners: @infra and @storage.

oncall-sre-bot: Created ticket INFRA-1329 and attached host logs.

Mira Patel: is there customer-visible correctness impact? I checked generation outputs — no hallucinations or truncation seen. only latency.

Kai (support): I updated Acme ticket: mitigation in progress, we've applied temporary routing and batching change. They acknowledged.

Jordan L: we've also enabled auto-fallback to the smaller q2_k8 model for new sessions as a protective measure if latency exceeds 2.5s for 30s.

Mira Patel: setting incident status -> mitigation. tagging for postmortem.

PagerDuty: Incident PD12345 escalated to L2 (Samir Rao) at 1832509502.

Samir Rao: taking lead for post-incident followup. Will coordinate with infra to remediate the disk IO root cause and plan replica replacement/rehab.

Mira Patel: preparing oncall handoff. My window ends in 20m. Current state: p99 ~1.8s, mitigations applied: excluded r-17,r-18; batch_size override to 1 for EU; fallback enabled to q2_k8. Customer impact: degraded latency for EU customers earlier, now mitigated. Next actions for incoming oncall: monitor INFRA-1329 updates, confirm host rebuild/replacement if IO persists, revert routing once replicas healthy, run smoke tests for critical customers (Acme).

Samir Rao: ACK takeover. will monitor for 30m and follow infra ticket. Mira — thanks, I'll post a short RCA draft once infra updates come in.

Mira Patel: handing off to Samir now. badge emoji :white_check_mark:

Samir Rao: taking handoff. leaving this channel thread as runbook anchor: https://confluence.internal/redwood/incidents/pd12345.

Mira Patel: thanks — logging final note and ending my shift.

Samir Rao: logged. I'll update if we need to escalate to oncall L3 or contact customers for a post-incident review.

incident-bot: Incident PD12345 marked as mitigated at 1832510199 (mitigation: traffic routing + batch override).
